release_notes:
🎉 ReSeen v1.0.4 Precision Interception & Xiaomi HyperOS Master Release:
• Redmi & Xiaomi Progressive Permission Flow: Sideloaded Restricted Settings resolution with native MIUI Security app & Special App Access fallbacks (solves missing 3-dots on Redmi 11+)
• Strict Exact Chat Name Matching: Completely eliminates contact name cross-talk & phantom group conversion
• Universal Phantom Status Filter: Automatically suppresses 'Your photo was sent', 'Downloading...', 'Photo saved', and background status notifications without losing real messages
• Instant Cloud License & Fleet Presence Sync: Authoritatively preserves Pro status on app clear data and reinstall so Admin Console accurately tracks VIP devices
• Referral Fleet Leaderboard: Full ranked leaderboard with gold/silver/bronze medals, search, and device breakdown
• Massive App Size Optimization: Reduced asset footprint by over 21MB for instant loading and lighter memory footprint
